name: 75143 · Kemp, TX
findings: ZIP 75143 (Kemp) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75143 (Kemp) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
